summary.name: Pages
summary.one_liner: Pages is Apple's word processing and page layout app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, offered free with in-app purchases.
use_cases: writing reports and resumes from templates
collaborating on documents in real time
summary.what_it_does: Pages lets users create documents from Apple-designed templates for reports, resumes, posters, and books, with support for shapes, tables, charts, images, audio, and video. It includes review tools such as comments, change tracking, and highlights, plus footnotes, endnotes, word and paragraph counts, and LaTeX or MathML equations. Documents can be exported as EPUB, Microsoft Word, RTF, TXT, and PDF, and shared or collaborated on via iCloud or Box. Apple Intelligence features include Writing Tools for proofreading and rewriting and Image Playground for generating images from descriptions.
notable: Free to download with in-app purchases, and editing and collaboration do not require a subscription
Exports interactive EPUB books and can publish to Apple Books
Imports and edits Microsoft Word and text files
Integrates with EndNote for citations on Mac (EndNote sold separately)
caveats: Some Apple Creator Studio and intelligence features require an Apple Intelligence-capable device and have usage limits
Requires iOS 26.0, iPadOS 26.0, or macOS 26.0 or later
In-app purchases listed include Intelligence Usage Pack $49.99, Monthly $12.99, and Annual $129.00
EndNote integration requires a separately sold EndNote product and plug-in
